done_when: From the second review round on, Forge itself keeps only the previous findings that are still open plus new P0 findings; any other new finding is recorded as a follow-up on the item, shown in close's advice, and does not block the merge; round-one reviews and the owner's choices at the round limit are unchanged; new and existing repos get it on upgrade
why: Repair-round reviews keep raising new P1 findings in code the repair did not change, although the repair-review prompt (src/forge/templates/review.md, Repair review) allows a new finding only when it is a P0 in normal use; 25 of 38 merged items since 17 Nov 2026 needed 3 or more rounds
